ref.substituent_description: Para-disubstituted benzene: OPh on one ring carbon and CH2 on the opposite (para) carbon. The CH2 joins a stereocentre CH bearing NHBoc (plain bond, up) and MeOOC (hashed bond, left).
ref.notes: Typeset. Benzene with three Kekule double bonds; one hashed bond from the stereocentre to MeOOC.

wrong.substituent_description: Circled benzene with OPh at the top vertex and the CH2 at the lower-left vertex, i.e. meta (1,3) to OPh. The CH2 joins a CH bearing NHBoc (plain bond, up) and MeOOC (hashed bond, left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The OO of MeOOC is heavily retraced/smudged but readable
Hashed bond strokes run up against the C of MeOOC
Ink is very dark purple-black on grey paper; read as black
wrong.notes: Handwritten photo on grey paper. Small ink dots at some ring vertices are pen blots, not bonds.

correct.substituent_description: Hexagon with a small inner circle: OPh at the upper-right vertex and CH2 at the lower-left vertex (para). The CH2 joins a CH bearing NHBoc (plain bond, up) and MeOOC (hashed bond, left).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: OO and final C of MeOOC are written as open loops but read as MeOOC
Dark ink blot on the lower-right ring bond, not a wedge
Small gap at the upper-left ring vertex
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. Aromatic ring shown with a small circle; one hashed bond to MeOOC.

errors_in_wrong.description: The reference has OPh para (1,4) to the CH2 side chain on the benzene ring. The wrong drawing puts OPh at the top vertex and the CH2 at the lower-left vertex, i.e. meta (1,3).

review_notes: Wrong drawing has OPh meta to the side chain instead of para. Labels, hashed bond and chain otherwise match. Corrected drawing restores para and matches the reference; handwriting is loose but readable.
